answer_1.quote: We focus on response generation ... which aims to generate a response that aligns with the action and topic in g_i^m, thereby actively steering the conversation towards the final target.

answer_2.quote: We follow previous work and use the following metrics: Word-level F1 (WF1), BLEU, Distinct (Dist), Knowledge F1 (KF1), and Goal Success Rate (Succ).

answer_4.quote: We conducted a pairwise human evaluation to compare the models with (w/) and without (w/o) CRC, assessing the consistency of the responses generated with each element of the dialogue context. We randomly selected 500 pairs of system responses from the DuRecDial dataset. The pairwise human evaluation results for TP-LLaMA3 are shown in Figure . The labels "win", "tie", and "lose" are used to indicate that TP-LLaMA3 w/ CRC is more consistent, equally consistent, or less consistent than TP-LLaMA3 w/o CRC, respectively. The evaluation criteria include Consistency with User Profile, Consistency with Dialogue History, Consistency with Domain Knowledge, and Consistency with Subgoals.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators (three NLP graduate students) independently judged each pair of responses using win/tie/lose labels for each of four consistency aspects: user profile, dialogue history, domain knowledge, and subgoal.
